ClientAddress.//: client -> Cloudflare -> Container Apps ingress -> app: the visitor is the second X-Forwarded-For entry from the right. Correct only while the origin accepts Cloudflare's ranges alone. ClientAddress__ForwardedHops overrides it.

HostAllowlist.//: The names the site answers to; anything else is a 400, except /healthz and /readyz (HostAllowlist.cs). The long name is this container app's own default domain, spelled out rather than *.azurecontainerapps.io, which is every container app on Azure; it changes only if the app or its environment is recreated. localhost is for `make run`. An empty list refuses to start outside Development. Override with HostAllowlist__Hosts__0, __1, ...
